div.div:
LEGEND & LAYERS
• Black solid (2.5 px): primary compass/passage movement (double arrowhead = two-way)
• Blue solid (2.8 px): vertical UPWAR / DOWN shaft (distinct from compass N/S)
• Purple dashed: magic word / special transition · Local markers: yellow = cross-page · orange = transient · red = death
• Optional layer [Parser Aliases / Fast Travel] (hidden by default): non-adjacent keyword shortcuts

div.div:
LOC_AWKWARD — Awkward canyonYou are in an awkward sloping east/west canyon.
EXITS (source precedence order)
1. DEPRE → LOC_GRATE [Ch 01] [not GRATE=GRATE_CLOSED]
2. ENTRA → LOC_BELOWGRATE
3. DOWN, EAST, DEBRI → LOC_DEBRIS
4. INWAR, UPWAR, WEST → LOC_BIRDCHAMBER
5. PIT → LOC_PITTOP

div.div:
LOC_BELOWGRATE — below the grateYou are in a small chamber beneath a 3x3 steel grate to the surface.
A low crawl over cobbles leads inward to the west.
EXITS (source precedence order)
1. OUT, UPWAR → LOC_GRATE [Ch 01] [not GRATE=GRATE_CLOSED]
2. OUT ✕ msg GRATE_NOWAY
3. CRAWL, COBBL, INWAR, WEST → LOC_COBBLE
4. PIT → LOC_PITTOP
5. DEBRI → LOC_DEBRIS

div.div:
LOC_BIRDCHAMBER — in bird chamberYou are in a splendid chamber thirty feet high. The walls are frozen
rivers of orange stone. An awkward canyon and a good passage exit
from east and west sides of the chamber.
EXITS (source precedence order)
1. DEPRE → LOC_GRATE [Ch 01] [not GRATE=GRATE_CLOSED]
2. ENTRA → LOC_BELOWGRATE
3. DEBRI → LOC_DEBRIS
4. CANYO, EAST → LOC_AWKWARD
5. PASSA, PIT, WEST → LOC_PITTOP

div.div:
LOC_DEBRIS — in debris roomYou are in a debris room filled with stuff washed in from the surface.
A low wide passage with cobbles becomes plugged with mud and debris
here, but an awkward canyon leads upward and west. In the mud someone
has scrawled, "MAGIC WORD XYZZY".
EXITS (source precedence order)
1. DEPRE → LOC_GRATE [Ch 01] [not GRATE=GRATE_CLOSED]
2. ENTRA → LOC_BELOWGRATE
3. CRAWL, COBBL, PASSA, LOW, EAST → LOC_COBBLE
4. CANYO, INWAR, UPWAR, WEST → LOC_AWKWARD
5. XYZZY → LOC_FOOF2 [Ch 01]
6. PIT → LOC_PITTOP

4. OVER, ACROS, WEST, CROSS ✕ msg NO_CROSS [not FISSURE=BRIDGED]
5. OVER → LOC_WESTBANK

div.div:
LOC_MISTHALL — in Hall of MistsYou are at one end of a vast hall stretching forward out of sight to
the west. There are openings to either side. Nearby, a wide stone
staircase leads downward. The hall is filled with wisps of white mist
swaying to and fro almost as if alive. A cold wind blows up the
staircase. There is a passage at the top of a dome behind you.
EXITS (source precedence order)
1. LEFT, SOUTH → LOC_NUGGET
2. FORWA, HALL, WEST → LOC_EASTBANK
3. STAIR, DOWN, NORTH → LOC_KINGHALL [Ch 03]
4. UPWAR, PIT, STEPS, DOME, PASSA, EAST → LOC_DOME [Ch 11] [carry NUGGET]
5. UPWAR → LOC_PITTOP
6. Y2 → LOC_JUMBLE [Ch 10]
